answer: Randomized Witness Assignment: each epoch, a public verifiable random function assigns every agent a fresh panel of peers to attest. An identity joins the garden only if its panel quorum confirms activity. On a knoll of limited attestation slots, each panel draws without replacement, so an attacker cloning identities cannot predict or corner assignments. Sybils must staff and verify every slot each epoch, paying continuous real coordination cost per clone rather than a one-time fee. Missed panels scatter clones across a mesa of unverified isolation.
